## Trigger Conditions

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Verify the recipient address has a valid trustline for the stream asset token and is authorized to receive transfers.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = RefusingFixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create(DEPOSIT, 0, 10 * DAY);
f.advance_time(DAY);
f.refuse(true, false);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_withdraw(&id, &(DEPOSIT / 10)));
```
